sourceTransform.note: Exact manufacturer STL cover plus every nonduplicate solid from the official Stamp-S3 KiCad STEP; one shared rigid Z translation -1.3mm, no scale. Board, mounting standoff, CHS-M2X3 screw, antenna and complete USB assembly retain native coordinates. Optional supplied loose headers are not soldered in the S007 base configuration.

omittedComponents.reason: Alternative full shield from the STEP is superseded by the separately published exact STL cover; importing both would overlap. All other 28 STEP solids retain their native positions.

buttons.notes: Conservative interior of the connected shield flexure cap; CAD top plane 2.35 mm, hit plane +0.02 mm. No deformation or new physical cap.

inspectionGroups.notes: Cover and its retained M2 screw move along local +Z to reveal inward PCB annotation; brass standoff remains onboard. 10 mm is a chosen inspection offset, not a verified physical disassembly path.

derivedParts.label: UNKNOWN
derivedParts.notes: Small annotation above actual PCB component-side plane; no second board. Manufacturer mechanical outline is known, but populated internal component layout is not. Outward underside has official photo; inward marker can be inspected with shield hidden or translucent.

Single WS2812B-2020 package location estimated from the bare-board official photograph using 18 mm board width. Package height/placement not measured CAD; retained shield can occlude it, no invented window or light pipe.

Photo-informed dark hexagonal indication on the native screw head; original STEP screw solid is retained unchanged. The source CAD omits the socket recess, so this surface is appearance only, not a modeled machined cavity or fit claim.

referencePhotos.cropNotes: Fixed documented ROI excludes unrelated cable/coin/packaging; original source is retained.

textures.mapping: Back-camera quadrilateral maps +X at photo left to -X at photo right. Original black PCB/silkscreen/pad pixels projected only on actual manufacturer board underside Z -2.299998 mm. Exact CAD holes/edges clip the photo; mounting standoff is excluded and kept as source geometry.
textures.uncertainty: Original 800×800 official photograph, native board ROI about 365×485 pixels. Slight camera/lens distortion and photo lighting remain; texture does not certify electrical layout or copper stack.
textures.method: Four explicit original-image film corners rectified by OpenCV getPerspectiveTransform/warpPerspective (Lanczos4); original-coordinate alpha ROI and hardware exclusions applied before warp. Original pixels only; projection uncertainty recorded, not independent geometry verification.

component-side.basis: Independent official photograph width and documented body width set camera scale/center only; no geometry scaling. Scope differences and manufacturer-dimension discrepancies remain failures.

label-side.basis: Independent official photograph width and documented body width set camera scale/center only; no geometry scaling. Scope differences and manufacturer-dimension discrepancies remain failures.

USB-end.basis: Qualitative camera orientation chosen from official photograph; perspective/crop not metrically calibrated.

shield-and-headers.basis: Qualitative camera orientation chosen from official photograph; perspective/crop not metrically calibrated.

back-oblique.basis: Qualitative reference of assembled S007 without soldered headers. No geometric scaling or perspective fit claimed.

front.basis: Official bare-S007 shield photo crop excludes coin. Reference is uniformly contained in 800×800; source 18 mm body width sets camera scale, no model scale.
front.registration: Uniform contain of original crop/photo in 800×800; camera span from independent 18 mm outer width, center from largest contour. Source geometry and aspect ratios unchanged.

back.basis: Source 18×24 mm mechanical PCB outline aligned to official backside photo; camera only, no geometry scale.
back.registration: Uniform contain of original crop/photo in 800×800; camera span from independent 18 mm outer width, center from largest contour. Source geometry and aspect ratios unchanged.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres

provenance.photoRights: Official product photographs copyright M5Stack / named manufacturer. No separate open photo license verified; retained for product reference, not relicensed under project MIT.

limitations: Exact source mechanical CAD includes PCB outline, one mounting standoff, one CHS-M2X3 screw, USB assembly and antenna. Other populated electronic components are not present as identified CAD parts.

The exposed underside uses a masked official PCB photograph; its visible appearance is known while unknown inward circuitry is marked UNKNOWN. Photo is not a verified electronic layout or component-height model.
Original 800×800 documentation photo is retained without invented upscaling; higher-resolution shop manifest request returned HTTP 429. Photo color is not calibrated reflectance.
Official 24 mm length describes the body while USB-inclusive source envelope is 25.948 mm; this scope discrepancy remains a failed whole-product dimension target rather than scaling the model.
Default S007 assembly has no soldered optional headers and no pin sticker, matching documented bare variant. Photographs of shield/headers alternatives are used only for qualitative details.
RGB package position is photograph-estimated below shield; actual optical emission and hidden component heights remain unverified.
Model validation does not establish firmware execution or physical hardware behavior.

Source screw head lacks its photographed hex socket; a thin hexagonal visual mark indicates it without claiming a cut recess. Native standoff flange, USB and copper-plating details remain less detailed than the product photograph; shallow cover embossing is view/light dependent.
